data.title: Public demo (wide-angle camera)
data.summary: Wide-angle viewing system forward-prediction demo on three pinned held-out MAST shots; rFID + centroid MSE acceptance.

sections.body: Three shots withheld from training; demo predicts frames N+1..N+30 given first N. Acceptance: rFID < 8 on each held-out shot and centroid trajectory MSE within 2 pixels.
Single-page HTML rendering the predicted vs ground-truth frames side-by-side as an animation. Hosted at simon-mcintosh.github.io/imas-ambix/demo.html alongside this plan.

decisions_def.title: Pinned held-out shot ids — auto-pick or hand-pick three?
decisions_def.context: Hand-pick: choose three shots covering different plasma regimes (ohmic, NBI-heated, disrupted). Auto-pick: random 3 from training-grade pool. Hand-pick is more demonstrative; auto-pick is more honest.
